name: Yanji and Dalian IT-worker groups and revenue

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel-reported Member State allegation with a China response and one company relationship lacking a response.

caveats: China said relevant employment contracts had expired by 22 December 2019 and reported implementation of repatriation obligations.
The Panel stated it had yet to receive a reply regarding Dalian Xinlu; manager/company claims remain Member State information.

statements: A Member State reported four Munitions Industry Department-subordinate IT-worker groups operating in Yanji, Jilin, in early 2020; two were closely linked to Yanji Silver Star Network Science and Technology Co. Ltd.

One 16-worker group at Yanji Development Zone Science and Technology Industrial Park reportedly earned nearly $1 million in 2019; a second 15-worker group was relocated from Cambodia and sponsored for entry by Yanji Silver Star.
Kim Ryu Song reportedly led a seven-worker team and controlled another five-person team; Kwon Kwang Ho led a separate seven-worker team.

Ma Tong Hyok was reported as a key Dalian-based IT manager involved in bringing workers to China, and Kim Han-su as a China-based worker and manager of multiple teams; Dalian Xinlu Science and Technology Co. Ltd. was linked to the investigation.

sources.support: Supports the four groups, team sizes, revenue, managers, company links and China response
